user_reviews.Name: Alex Koretsky
user_reviews.Description:
I can't recommend SPS Plumbing enough as they saved me thousands and restored my faith in honest service! My tankless water heater (just 4 months out of warranty) started acting up, so I called three different plumbers. All of them even highly rated ones on Yelp and Google, inspected it and said I needed a full replacement. The quotes?  6,000 to 8,000. I was devastated, thinking I'd have to shell out a fortune.

I vented to a friend about it, and they immediately suggested Steve at SPS Plumbing. I called, and Steve and Vanessa were amazing from the get-go. They listened to my story, calmed me down, and assured me not to worry and they could fix it without replacing the whole unit. Their quote came in under $500 for parts and labor. What a relief!

They ordered the parts right away and scheduled the repair for just a day after everything arrived. Ruben showed up on time, was super friendly and professional, and knocked out the entire job quickly and cleanly. My water heater's been running perfectly ever since.

Honestly, I feel like those other plumbers were either trying to take advantage of the situation or just didn't know how to handle the repair. Don't fall for the big-ticket upsell just call SPS first. Steve, Vanessa, and Ruben are the real pros. Grateful beyond words!

user_reviews.Name: Misha S
user_reviews.Description:
I had a great experience with Freddy and his team at Freedom Underground at my Menlo Park residence.

It was a hairy situation where I needed to install a new sewer line down a shared driveway and into the public street. Various permits and inspections from the city as well as the sanitary district were needed, I had some concerned neighbors to deal with, and we had to do it in a way that protects a large heritage tree right near the work.

Freddy was extremely patient and creative during the scoping process. He understood the requirements and concerns of all parties involved and offered different solutions based on what the needs were. He and his office manager Fiona did a good job of managing all the admin stuff as well. I never felt like the team didn't know what they were doing or didn't have a plan.

Once the job started, Miguel did an excellent job managing the work and the team. His communication was great and he quickly corrected course based on any concerns or requirements raised. Miguel was a good foreman.

I felt in good hands the whole time and I thought the team was very diligent in cleaning up each day, keeping me updated on progress, etc. I'd definitely work with them again.

user_reviews.Name: Mahmud Ischanov
user_reviews.Description:
My 60 year old galvanized main water line pipe decided to spring a leak one cold Saturday evening... I had to scramble to turn the water off at the meter. As soon as I did, I started calling around plumbers that could come out quick to help me fix the pipe, as i had no water in the house of 5 people. No showers, washing hands or using toilets.
4 guys came out, Freddy from Freedom was 2nd lowest offer. What sold me on his quote was that he was going to use a trenchless tunneling system called the HammerHead (minimize trenching and destruction of 50 feet of my yard) and the fact that he suggested that he install a pressure regulator without being asked (unlike the other plumbers). The pressure regulator is important because after replacing a 60 year old corroded galvanized steel pipe with brand new copper line, the water pressure in the house could go up dramatically, causing damage to appliances and pipes in the house. Freddy even agreed to install a Flo by Moen leak detection system at no additional charge.
I am glad I decided to go with Freddy, his guys showed up on time the next morning, as agreed. His crew of guys (Christian and 4 others) worked non-stop, tirelessly and professionally. I could definitely tell the guys take pride in their work, they all did a fantastic job.
I would recommend Freddy and Freedom Underground, they are awesome!

user_reviews.Name: Ashish Kalani
user_reviews.Description:
Freedom Underground Plumbing replaced our main sewer and water lines. The main sewer line replacement was done entirely trench-less, whereas the water line replacement was a combination of trench-less and open trench. The entire work was done in a timely manner and with great quality; we passed inspections without any issues. The water line replacement was a bit complex with multiple turns. The crew used smooth turns on the line where possible and we have had no drop in water pressure in the house or in the irrigation lines. The crew did its best to leave the landscape looking as much like before as possible. They even put back the grass cover that had to be removed for digging a wide hole.

Freddy, the owner, gave me a quote that was competitive with the others I received. However I chose to go with Freedom Underground because Freddy genuinely seemed interested in providing the best solution for our needs. The foremen, Alex and Christian were both very responsive to my questions and kept me up-to-date with what was being done. I requested a change-order for replacing part of the sewer line under the house, and the quote provided was reasonable.

Overall, I am very happy with the experience and whole-heartedly recommend Freedom Underground for underground replacement work.

user_reviews.Name: Phil Ammirato
user_reviews.Description:
Terrible value/communication, but technical work seems good.

Feel taken advantage of, new homeowner with a leak in the wall behind the shower. They showed up to give a quote, pressured me to sign quickly.  I was stupid to panic and not get more quotes. Then when they come to do the work a few hours later they tell me for the first time they will have to replace the shower trim, give me no choice besides a chrome trim when I have bronze existing (obvious mismatch).

I later got other quotes after for less than half (wall was still open when they came so they could see everything). I look for 5 minutes on Home Depot’s website site and find a matching trim, install myself in another five minutes.

Positives: leak is fixed. The folks that did the technical work were friendly and did good work (I don’t blame them for the trim decision/communication). Wall repair was good.

Still feel we did not get a good value from the company, but learned an expensive lesson about dealing with stressful home repairs.

I am a member w/PCH Services on the plumbing side but had an HVAC issue because our dryer wasn’t completely drying. Years ago the dryer vent was clogged up so I suspected it was clogged with lint & who knows what again.

They went outside & discovered it was bird nesting, feathers & eggs built up over time that had caused all the blockage and possibly triggered the safety switch on the heating element if dryer.

Now that it’s clear, this major problem is solved & hopefully my dryer will be working properly. Otherwise, I’m extremely happy with their service & will continue to use them it the future!

Thanks again to Luis & Junior!

user_reviews.Description:

I appreciate the staff who answer the phone in a timely manner and that they could schedule someone to come a soon as possible. Juan came within the hours he was slated to arrive. All in all, my mom is, again, very happy with the work that is done in just 2 days. Thank you!

I had a great experience with Fluid Dynamics and would certainty recommend them to others. My commercial water heater broke at my On-Premise-Laundry facility and I reached out to them because I knew their facility was close by and had seen their van around. I heat water constantly and it is an important part of cleaning laundry.

Ronald came out in a couple of hours to inspect my water heater and give me options repairing or replacing it and what might have led me to this point. I appreciated that he wasn't trying to sway me in either direction and was sharing his knowledge about how to evaluate the decision.  I decided to replace it and add a thermal expansion tank. Also got a utility sink quoted and setup for install.

We schedule for the replacement when I could stop operations for a few hours for Vince and Lalo to complete the install. They arrived a few minutes early to get the old water heater draining so when the new one was delivered it could wheel from the truck right into place. Vince worked through the project diligently, was clean in his workspace and left my shop looking good. Took all the trash away and ensured we I was back to washing as fast as possible.

This vendor was excellent to work with. From the initial conversation through delivery, they were organized, responsive, and transparent. I thought the value for the service was good. They handled everything professionally and followed through on every commitment.

user_reviews.Name: Jacquelin Lloyde
user_reviews.Description:
I am 94 years old and live by myself, and it can be very difficult for me to manage home repairs. I do not use the internet very much, but Joseph kindly showed me how to use speech-to-text on my phone so I could leave this review myself. I truly wanted people to know how wonderful he was.

For weeks, there was a loud humming noise every time I used the water, and it was driving me crazy. At my age, you appreciate peace and quiet, and the sound was very upsetting.

From the moment he arrived, he treated me with patience, kindness, and respect. I am hard of hearing and move slowly because of arthritis, and he never once rushed me. He took his time to listen carefully and explain everything in a way I could understand.

He didn’t just fix the problem — he checked my whole plumbing system to make sure everything was safe. No plumber has ever done that for me before.

He even had to cut into some of the stucco to do the repair properly, and I was worried the price might go up. It never did. He kept his word exactly. That meant a lot to me.

In my long life, I have met many contractors. Joseph stands out as one of the most honest, hardworking, and compassionate young men I have ever encountered. His workmanship is beautiful, and his character is even better.

If you want someone who truly cares, who does the job right, and who treats you like family, call Allstar Plumbing and ask for Joseph.

Thank you, Joseph. You really are an Allstar.

user_reviews.Name: Gregory Dibb
user_reviews.Description:
I needed my septic tank completely pumped out so I could start getting rid of it.  I called a couple of different places and Able had the best price, but they charge extra if it takes them longer than half an hour.  Well they came and did a fabulous job.  Very helpful, very thorough--helped dig around the tank, etc.  The only problem is it took them 1.5 hours, which ended up costing me quite a bit more than the original quote.  For me 5 star service would mean that before working that extra time and going that extra mile they ask me.  I might have said yes because they did do a good job, but I might have been okay after just 30 mins.

So my advice to company is: ask the customer if they prefer the extra work/cleaning or if they prefer to rush and stay under 30 mins.  my advice to customer: be clear you expect the job to be done in 30 mins, so they aren't extra helpful and then charge you for it.

user_reviews.Name: Teri Chiang
user_reviews.Description: I could not be happier with the HUGE job EJ Plumbing did for me. My slow shower drain turned out to be caused by disintegrated plumbing under my 70-year old house (tree roots came up when they snaked the drain, ugh). Jonathan was extremely helpful in diagnosing it, and supervisor Ryan Kennedy came right away to work out potential solutions to a very extensive and expensive problem. Ryan and Jonathan used a camera with a tracker to trace the issue through the lines. No perfect options with rotting plumbing under a slab. They listened to my priorities and we agreed on the best, least invasive solution. They came out promptly to start the job - a whole team digging through my brick walkway and front yard to replace the outdoor line, followed by cutting into my drywall to spray an epoxy liner through my indoor lines. They were extremely careful, hardworking and professional. Best of all, they took such incredible care putting everything back, including my yard, drywall and checkerboard brick walkway. Above and beyond!!! I am so impressed. Very very happy with EJ's honesty, reliability, professionalism, skill and even artistry. I had used them before for a small, simple job but this was a huge, difficult effort and I could not be more pleased. Thanks to Ryan, Jonathan, Ivan, Gerardo and the whole team at EJ for your excellent service!!!

user_reviews.Name: Joe Falcone
user_reviews.Description: The work was OK, the problem was the loose relationship with the truth and upsell.  We had a clogged toilet and the normal approach without an accessible cleanout would be to remove the toilet ($500) plus snake the line ($500+) and you're done.  Instead they sold us on putting in a two-way cleanout ($3700) which was OK since it needed it anyway but then they tried to sell us on replacing all of the plumbing underneath the house ($11000) claiming that the cast iron sewer line had corroded and crumbled.  See the flow of the line in the video - it was perfectly fine.  The guy that is initially sent out is a salesman - not sure he's a licensed plumber since he doesn't do any of the work, just the estimate.  He tries to maximize the value of the deal for the plumbing company.  Bottom line: use a local plumber with good references who doesn't try to upsell.

user_reviews.Name: Peter Fera
user_reviews.Description:
Problem: Gurgling noise under floor after flushing toilet. Had one
overflow in past year.

No blockages were found.

Plumber used snake camera to visualize length of sewage drain. Discovered a marginal region in PVC joint with vent pipe that could cause temporary partial blockage of solid waste. No repair needed. Advised owner to double flush as needed.

Toilet was not removable. Possibly stuck from floor tile cement. He used other toilet on same sewage line to run camera cable.

Excellent diagnosis.

user_reviews.Name: Dalena
user_reviews.Description:
Cesar and Francisco came out this week to help us diagnose ongoing drain clogs and a persistent odor issue at my business, and I cannot recommend them enough.

From the moment they arrived, they were punctual, professional, and incredibly thorough. As a business owner, I had a long list of questions and concerns, and they took the time to patiently walk me through every single detail without ever making me feel rushed.

Since I didn’t have access to the plumbing blueprints for our plaza, they went above and beyond by using a camera and locator to accurately map out the pipe system, including identifying shared lines. That level of effort alone gave me so much clarity and peace of mind.

They conducted a full camera inspection, explained the condition and age of the pipes, and helped me clearly understand what was causing the issues. What really stood out was how knowledgeable and honest they were. They didn’t only point out problems, they provided multiple solutions and helped me choose the most practical and cost-effective option.

Their customer service was unmatched compared to the many plumber we’ve had before. They were patient, transparent, and genuinely cared about helping us solve the issue the right way. On top of that, they provided a detailed report that made everything easy to understand and reference moving forward.

If you’re looking for a plumbing team that is reliable, skilled, and goes above and beyond for their clients, Cesar and Francisco are the ones to call. I will for sure be using them for any future needs!

user_reviews.Name: Kevin Wang
user_reviews.Description:
I hired this company in Sept 2024 to repair a toilet leak in the wall (stains exfiltrated on the wall). About 1.5 years later In April 2026 the exactly same problem happened again. I called them again to conduct the same repair and the technician confirmed there is no other problems with the pipe. So this has to do with either parts quality or workmanship. Other toilets in the same building could have the same the problem but the repair usually last 10 years or more. So 1.5 years is definitely unusual according to the property manager.
When I called the owner Scott. He rejected any requests to waive the labor or any discount, instead, he threatened to charge more if I keep talking to him.
This time, the leak went into the downstair unit and their bathroom paint is wrinkled - I will have to spend another $2000 for the drywall and repaint for the neighbor downstairs.
I will not hire this company again.

user_reviews.Name: Carol Yamane
user_reviews.Description:
In October, the hot water shower fixture got stuck I contacted Local Rooter and Plumbing for assistance. The valves in the hot and cold fixtures were replaced by Local Rooter and Plumbing in 2021 and the cold water fixture was tightened in 2024. Since this was the 3rd issue with the shower fixtures, Duy recommended converting the fixtures from 2 handle to single handle. During the conversion, Jaime found the plumbing was galvanized steel and recommended installing copper piping. A hole was cut in the wall behind the shower and the pipe was replaced. Wall patch, texturing, and painting was done once the job was completed.
I also asked Duy for advice regarding replacing the gas hot water heater. Since the heater was 21 years old, Duy suggested replacing the hot water heater with another gas water heater after a discussion about converting to an all electric one.
Duy is very responsive to emergency plumbing issues by scheduling an appointment within hours, all of my emergencies happened on a weekend. He explains the problem and repairs required well.  I also had him replace the original plumbing under the house in 2021. I highly recommend this company.

user_reviews.Name: Elaine Chang
user_reviews.Description: I've never written a review before but Giovani did such a superb job that I had to!  My house of horrors from the 1960s has seen more than it's fair share of plumbers coming through but hands down, San Jose Drain and Main is the real deal.  My 13 year old son (who doesn't know his own strength) broke the shower handle.  Unfortunately, it wasn't as simple as replacing the shower handle as the shower cartridge was stuck and the valve needed to be replaced.  I contacted 7 plumbers before I reached out to Giovani and they all said the tile had to be broken in order to access the valve and replace it.  Giovani said he wasn't sure if he had to break the tile but he would try to avoid it. He ran through his proposed solution with me and it made sense so I had Giovani come back another day after he bought the parts.  He came on time as promised and took out the old cartridge and valve and welded the new valve into a very tight space (see picture) without having to break the tile!  He gave me a quote at the beginning of the job and even though it took way longer than anticipated (he was here from 2 pm to 7:30 pm), he still stuck to his original quote.  Now, that's what I call service and a job well done! Thank you Giovani and San Jose Drain and Main!!!

user_reviews.Name: Joshua Bloch
user_reviews.Description:
Venture Plumbing did a large and complex repipe on our house, including a new sewer lateral, replacement of all waste pipes in the house, replacement of about 30% of our hot and cold water supply plumbing, replacement of several sinks and toilets, and installation of a Grundfos hot water recirculation system. The work required over a week with a five-person crew and was complicated by the presence of irreplaceable handmade tiles.

Their bid was not the cheapest, but neither was it the most expensive, and they definitely offered value for money. They were happy to accommodate special requests (e.g., installing unions for serviceability), and they are very much full-service plumbers. They contract with subcontractors to do tile and paint work, promising to leave your house in the condition they found it and to leave plumbing fully functional at the end of every working day. In our experience, they did exactly that.

Their communication was excellent before, during, and after the work. Their work exceeded our expectations, and their people exude competence, integrity, friendliness, and respect. They are a big enough organization to get things done quickly and efficiently, but small enough to operate with a human touch. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Francois Goldfain
user_reviews.Description:
Wow, I am impressed. I usually get disappointed and frustrated when I deal with home-improvement contractors.  A lot of companies claim that they are customer-focused and yet most of them can barely respect an appointment on time, respond to your emails/calls in a timely manner, or give you accurate information. With FUSE, it is the first time that I have dealt with a company that delivers on all aspects from the beginning to the end of my project, and beyond.  I would definitely use them again.  FUSE is a very organized company with different people responsible for different tasks. They are all well coordinated and all of them have been terrific for my project.

I hired them in September 2025 for my HVAC project: replace my gas furnace with a highly efficient air-air Heap Pump and redesign/replace the ducting system for my main house, as well as add a 2nd  Heat Pump with a ductless mini-split for a small ADU.

Front-end. Russel was the advisor, who first visited my house to estimate the work. He answered all my questions, both on site and many times via email & SMS after his visit. He promptly updated my quote several times as I requested changes and additions, including some extra unrelated tasks. He also added the advertised discounts and the rebates I could qualify for (which many other vendors could not clearly identify). My very positive experience with Russel is ultimately the main reason I proceeded with FUSE.

- On-site work. Eugene was the lead technician and was helped by 2 other team members. The work was completed with high quality and on-schedule. Eugene kept me informed on their progress and involved me a few times when unexpected issues raised and a customer decision was needed. Eugene was competent, friendly and gained my trust. Even after the work was completed, he stayed responsive when I reached out to him as I faced an electrical problem a few days later. He visited back my house on the very same day with one of FUSE electrician, who identified the HVAC work did not cause it and still ended up addressing the unrelated issue in the panel (turned out to be trivial).

Handy man. In order to patch and paint the holes that were needed for the project, FUSE sent a handy man. Norah from FUSE did the scheduling and kept me informed of possible time change; FUSE also communicated accurately all the work that needed to be done by the handy man. Even though Eduard the handy man was sub-contracted and not a FUSE employee, he delivered a very high quality work as well and it was another very positive experience. Only possible improvement was that FUSE could not schedule this sooner (I had to wait 3 weeks after main work was completed).

Permit. The permit department coordinated with me to schedule the city inspection. They also promptly responded when I needed additional permit paperwork to submit my SVCE rebate application. On the day of the inspection, Alex was the FUSE employee that called me to ensure I would be home at the scheduled time. He showed up before the city inspector to verify everything was correct and guided the inspector, who congratulated him on the high quality work FUSE did. As I was chatting with Alex, I mentioned that some minor adjustment could be done with the dampers. Before the day was over, Norah reached out to let me know she will be working on scheduling of a technician for that. That's what I call being coordinated and following through!

Rebates. Maria was the rebates coordinator. She, too, was very responsive and properly submitted the Tech Clean rebate on my behalf. She correctly set time expectation with me and sent me the check promptly once she received it. The FUSE support team also promptly send me the additional invoice break-down I needed for the SVCE rebate. It was great to see how FUSE was supporting me in getting the rebate I could qualify for.

Over all, I am extremely satisfied of the experience I received from FUSE and I highly recommend them. Considering the valuable service they provided me, I am actually considering signing up for their maintenance plan.

user_reviews.Name: Alan Lee
user_reviews.Description:
For my issue, it was a kitchen sewer line that was leaking for past year underneath my crawlspace, and I was very pleased with the service that Chris and his team provided.

I cannot emphasize how professional and prompt Chris was to come to inspect the area. The crawlspace was a mess with sewage built up from the leaky sewer pipe with mold / flies / critters everywhere. We found out that the plumbing system was not assembled to code by previous ownership. Like other reviewers, he didn't even need to go down crawlspace and knew what was happening - which to me means he's definitely seen this many times, especially in aging homes in Bay Area! He immediately offered two options - one long term vs affordable option. Not wanting to sacrifice quality, I chose the long term option which was replacing the whole pipe / bringing the whole kitchen plumbing network to building code.

Chris and his team offered to fix the pipes and clean everything up at very reasonable prices with warranty as well. In half a day, everything was done and we saw immediate improvement in reduced sewer smell and flies.

Highly recommended. I'm looking forward to seeing whether to upgrade my future plumbing system like water pipes.

user_reviews.Name: Chaozhong Lian
user_reviews.Description:
I wholeheartedly recommend United HVAC, Plumbing & Electrical. I recently hired them to replace the original 1961 HVAC ductwork in my house, and they did a wonderful, extremely professional job. I am beyond satisfied with the results.

You don't just have to take my word for it--I actually took pictures of their completed work, uploaded them to Google Gemini, and asked the AI to evaluate the installation. Even the AI praised their work, calling it a "top-tier, textbook installation"! (See the screenshots below).

During the bidding process, I compared United with another company. United's quote was slightly higher, but choosing them was absolutely the best decision. Their program manager, Tim, was incredibly easy to work with. He quickly identified asbestos tape on my 1961 ducts and insisted we use a C-22 licensed abatement company to remove it safely and provide all the legal documentation for future reference. The other company offered a cheaper route by doing the removal themselves, but for something as dangerous as asbestos, doing it by the book is well worth the minor price difference.

I also want to give a massive shoutout to Bair (Bayar) for his exceptional craftsmanship. He is easy-going, friendly, and really listened to all of my concerns. He provided great recommendations on how the new ductwork should be organized, and actually used a machine to fine-tune and balance the air pressure throughout the house. To top it all off, he even carefully reorganized the insulation in my attic after the work was done! It's this kind of attention to detail that makes them stand out.

The pictures speak for themselves. If you want true professionals who care about safety, honesty, and quality craftsmanship, go with United HVAC.

user_reviews.Name: Anna Quan
user_reviews.Description:
We used Marti's Plumbing Service for an emergency water heater change-out in June, 2021. We also asked that they apply for a building permit on our behalf, and Marti's agreed.

The technician sent by Marti's did not install all of the necessary parts for the water heater. He also cut the line between the water heater and the washer and caused a leak. Only after multiple conversations did Marti's compensate us for the amount that we had paid to repair the leak.

Marti's also refused to apply for a building permit after their initial promise, so I applied for a water heater change-out permit on my own. I received the following list of corrections from the City of Cupertino's building inspector. I called Marti's many times to bring the water heater up to code, because they provide a one-year warranty with their services, but it was very difficult to reach them to schedule a follow-up visit.

City of Cupertino's List of Required Corrections:

1. Single wall vent connector for water heater requires 6" min clearance to combustibles ( Sheetrock ) and single wall connector not approved for penetrating rated assembly.
2. Provide access to vent flue to verify B-vent or install new for water heater flue.
3. Provide insulation on first 5'ft of water lines at water heater
4. T&P piping at termination to not be threaded and to terminate 6-24" off garage floor or pipe to exterior and maintain same termination clearance off ground surface
5. Water heater to be fully blocked and braced
6. Water heater bracing at lower brace to be located within bottom 1/3 and 4" above control valve
7. Tighten water heater bracing
8. Provide water bond hot to cold and to gas line.
9. Provide approved expansion tank brace and install per manufactures installation instructions
10. Provide sediment trap on gas line after the valve and before the flex

user_reviews.Name: dusty simon
user_reviews.Description:
I had a very disappointing experience with Roto-Rooter on a recent sewer job. I paid around $10,000 for work that is still not completed over a week later, and communication has been extremely poor throughout the process.

During the excavation, a trench over 7 feet deep was left open and workers entered the hole without any shoring or trench protection in place. This created serious safety concerns and appeared to violate basic OSHA safety requirements. I also have video evidence of the conditions on site.

In addition, there was an attempt to upsell me an additional “two-way cleanout” for about $6,000 after the original work was already underway and paid for. I have video evidence of that conversation as well, and it felt misleading based on how it was presented.

user_reviews.Name: PJs Consulting
user_reviews.Description: I hired Jose’s plumbing in January 2026 to re-pipe my entire home which had Pex plastic water pipes and to replace all the Pex with copper water pipes. Jose came to my house to take a look at what I had going on. He was very knowledgeable and answered all my questions. He provided me with timely quote for the work I wanted to have completed. I got 4 estimates for this job. Jose was not the  low bidder nor was he the highest. Low bidder is not always best from my perspective. My home is 4 bedroom with 3 full baths with a laundry room. Jose told me that he could complete this job in 1 day. I thought there is no way all that work would get done in 1 day and that he was just trying to get the work. We agreed on a start day. Jose asked that I clear out under all the sinks and move some other things out of the way so they could get right to work when they showed up. Jose said he would be there at 8:00am. Jose and his crew were all on time. Jose brought 8 plumbers with him and got right to work. They protected all my floors & walls and tented all the areas they were going to be working to capture any dust and materials. The crew took a 30 min lunch and right back to work. When they finshed all the work, they all cleaned everything up. Jose tested the system for about 30 mins just to make sure there were no leaks. Everything was good. They took all the old materials with them. I certainly had the choice on what plumbing company I wanted to do this job. Jose and his Crew were top notch and hardworking. It was quite impressive that they finished this large job in 1 day. I had a couple questions the next day and Jose said he would send 1 of his guys over to my home that afternoon to show me in person. It was a really good experience for me. I was really happy with Jose’s Plumbing and there talented Crew. I highly recommend Jose’s Plumbing for all your plumbing needs.

user_reviews.Description:
Update 2026:
We recently had low pressure in water softener & these were the guys I first remembered & called. So they made a visit & told would charge me $199(which wasnt the case last year). I was also looking to upgrade my water heater & some electrical upgrade. The quote they sent me was unreasonable from any standards(upgrade is good to have & not need to have). A friend who visited showed us how to bypass the water softener & install a descalar which will not let hard water lump(which is biggest issue) That was $200 solution to thousands of dollars quoted. Anyways, its been three months & I was sent invoice for their visit & I duly paid. But I wont give them anymore business(penny wise, pound foolish I think). I am still looking for a company that can do good job, take honest money & I can depend on.
=====
It all started with our dishwasher which stopped working because of low water pressure. My wife looked up for few plumbers & gave call to United to get estimate. The technician who came diagnosed it to valve issue & replaced it at very reasonable price. Then they noted some leaks in our sewer & water pipes during crawl space visit. My wife decided to get a quote for upgrading sewer pipes.

Sean came in & provided quote to fix water pipes as well as remove cast iron sewer pipes and replace with plastic ones. Fast forward, united matched another quote I had and I signed up. They started the work very next day.

Rinat Shai came with his crew & boy, what a hard worker he is. For the two days he spent under my crawl space, he spent very less time wasting, including lunch break. He went above & beyond to get all the work get finished within promised two days. Infact he worked on both independence day & next day, which most of us spend drinking or traveling. I am very very happy with his work attitude.

I would highly recommend United to anyone considering repairs or upgrades. I look forward to have mutually rewarding business relationship with this company.

user_reviews.Name: David Evans
user_reviews.Description:
After Christmas Eve 2025, both of my bathroom sinks (Master and Guest, sharing the same wall) stopped draining. I tried chemical drain cleaner and even a drill powered auger, but neither worked. I searched online for plumbing companies in Fremont, CA, and United HVAC Plumbing & Electrical came up as one of the recommended options.
I called United and left a message, then contacted another company that offered a free onsite estimate. While I was waiting for them to arrive, United called me back and suggested I still book an appointment, which I did.
The first company’s assessment wasn’t encouraging. Because both sinks share the same drainpipe, they said there was no guarantee their auger would work either. Their next suggestion was snaking the roof vent for $500 with no guarantee or cutting into the drywall to replace Tee fittings, with Y fittings — still without addressing the clog. I was glad I had a second appointment lined up.
When United’s technician, Teo V, arrived, I explained the previous assessment. He mentioned the roof vent option as well, but before going that route, he offered to try his auger. He removed the J trap and waste arm — something I hadn’t been able to do — and within minutes, he cleared the clog. We ran water for 15 minutes to ensure no backup. While waiting, he cleaned the area, repacked his tools. He also replaced a worn wall gasket before reinstalling the entire P trap assembly.
Now came the moment of truth, the bill — and I was pleasantly surprised at how reasonable it was.
I’m writing this review to recognize Teo V’s skill, persistence, and professionalism. He saved me from unnecessary work and expensive guesses. Excellent service at a fair price.

user_reviews.Name: Anna Ryzhkova
user_reviews.Description:
We've been using Miracle Plumbing for years, and at first everything was solid and we continued coming back to them. They are a bit pricey, but we thought we were paying for quality. However, things have changed for us in the recent years.

We had a problem with a downstairs toilet where there was a slow leak and water damaged wood around the toilet. MP came and replaced the wax ring, spilling the water all over our wooden floors in the process (this wax ring has been replaced by a few other plumbers before and everything remained dry). It took me hours to clean the floor and even walls after that. They've acknowledged it and even brought over water remediation company that did some treatment (no issues here). However, the leak came back and we called MP again. At this point they recommended that we replace a pipe under the toilet. It was expensive, but we agreed. Pipe was replaced and the toilet installed again. Not much time passes and we see discoloration on the wood floor again indicating a leak. We called them and were told that we are seeing things, this is old discoloration and there is no leak. Discoloration persisted and at some point we saw actual water coming through, but made a mistake of not making a video of it. We called MP again, they came out and told us again that there is no leak and promised that a supervisor will call (still waiting). We saw water again after this (this time we made a video) and just decided to replace the toilet and called a different plumber. When the toilet was removed, we saw that the pipe that was installed by MP is uneven with the floor, one edge sticks above the floor and the other edge is below the floor (photo attached). It is obvious that when the toilet sits on an uneven pipe like this, there will be leaks no matter the wax ring, the toilet was not even stable, you could shake it because of the angle of the pipe to which it is attached. The other plumber brought a level to further demonstrate how uneven it is. Moral of the story is that not only did they make us feel like complete lunatics for "seeing" water, but in the end they did not even do a quality job for which we paid over $1,000. In the end we are out of the money we spent on this pipe replacement and now have to pay someone else do it again to fix the issue with the poor installation, and MP did not offer us to correct it or issue any form of refund (we've informed them of the issue).

The above incident is the one that stands out to me, but in the last few years, we've had complaints about pretty much all of their visits (unfortunately, plumbing issues happen a lot in our old house), from leaving absolute mess to recommending costly replacements of equipment when all that was required is to flip a part that was installed incorrectly (not by them to be fair).

All in all, I would not recommend MP to anyone based on our collective experiences.

user_reviews.Name: Dan Bouchet
user_reviews.Description:
A reminder that good people still exist.

This week I had a plumbing issue at my house and called Alert Plumbing, a local family-owned company. After two days of hard work, Raul Ochoa and his son completed the repair.

During the job we talked. I shared that I recently lost my wife and am now raising two teenagers on my own. When I asked for the total, Raul said, “Dan, you have enough on your plate. This job is on us. Take care of yourself and your kids.”

I insisted. He refused.

In a time when life feels overwhelming, their kindness meant more than they will ever know. They didn’t just fix a plumbing issue — they reminded me that compassion is still alive and well.

They have a customer for life.

Thank you, Raul and Jose.

user_reviews.Name: Geoffrey Noer
user_reviews.Description: Champion Plumbing has been our go-to plumber for several years now for our home and also for our multi-unit rental property. Both are >100 year-old buildings that have a lot more plumbing needs than we'd choose to have. We have worked with most of Champion's plumbers by now on quite a variety of jobs, including several major ones (underground gas line replacement, main water line replacement, two complex full repipe jobs) as well as more modest projects (hot water heater replacements, replacing hose bibs). If your job is a large one that's going to take several days with more than one plumber, I would suggest asking that their owner Tim take a look and help scope the work and assign the right members of their crew so it can be done efficiently. All plumbers are expensive, but Champion is more reasonable than many, they're professional, and do high quality work. We recommend them highly! (Note: this is an unsolicited review that accurately reflects our experience).

user_reviews.Name: Anurag Tomar
user_reviews.Description:
This heater was installed by Jose at Superior Plumbing, 8 months back. Jose did a meticulous job, replacing pipe connectors, putting in new shut-off valves, securely strapping the tank to the wall studs.
However, last week unit shutdown with error code of "10 red flashes". Switching off, and restarting the pilot light resolves the issue, but as this was 2nd time in 6 weeks, Rocky from Superior Plumbing came out to inspect it. Rocky contacted the manufacturer, and by their suggestion, took the burner out and cleaned it, polished the sensor and cleaned the fire chamber, and blew some compressed air through the flute. It seems collected lint and dust can cause this issue. If it happens again, maybe the sensor needs replacing.
Anyway, no charge for this service. Rocky was professional, efficient and courteous. Took him a little over an hour to inspect, talk to manufacturer and finish the work.  Hopefully we will not need to replace the sensor.

user_reviews.Name: Uygar Aral
user_reviews.Description:
I have worked with Elber from Drain & Plumbing on a couple occasions and he is excellent at his craft.

The first time I worked with him, it was an urgent situation where I needed the the hot and cold valves for our Washing Machine replaced in order to have our new Washer installed. The original valves had a lot of deposit build up, so when we tried to hand close it, it would still leak.

When I contacted Elber that morning, he had told me that scope would be too much for him to handle in the morning, because he was already committed to another project. However, he was able to come by later that day and in a few hours, he was able to replace both valves and the Outlet Box. 2 years later, it is still as good as new without any issues.

The second time I worked with Elber was for 2 tasks. I needed the PRV (Pressure Reducing Valve) replaced as it had severely corroded and the gasket inside was failing. We had been having water pressure issues and it was attributed to the original PRV. The second task was to install a Fleck 5600 Water Softener system that I had purchased online from Aplus Water via Amazon. Elber was able to complete both tasks in about 8 hours including having to buy the PRV as well as some additional copper pipes to ensure that he properly welded and installed the piping.

You can see from the pictures how corroded the original PRV was, simply based on the pipe surrounding the new install. He was able to easily and quickly replace the old PRV without incident.

The Water Softener took longer to install, but he was meticulously done. He made sure to properly survey the installation space and area in the garage. He reviewed and inspected the parts/connections as well as confirmed the installation process via the manual. I actively worked with him to ensure that everything needed to prepare in advance was good: verified the location and how it would be installed; verified where the closes drain would be that required him to enter the crawl space; verified all necessary parts from the manufacturer were good, before starting.

He went off to pick up some additional material to ensure that he would install and setup the resin tank and brine basin in a secure and clean setup. As you can see from the pictures he properly secured and mounted the system, performed the necessary and appropriate plumbing work to ensure all the interconnects were done properly. He then also ensured the drain from the resin tank ran properly under the house to the nearby drain.

Throughout the installation process, I occasionally checked in but did not need to hover over him. Overall the project took longer than he anticipated and expected, but he did not charge me extra. He had already scoped the project, previously, and committed to his original quote.

Elber at Drain & Plumbing is polite, honest, and easy to communicate with. Most importantly, he is extremely skilled and meticulous with his work. The quality of his workmanship is fantastic and I can't imagine is matched.

I do not plan to ever reach out to anybody else but Elber for any of my plumbing needs.

Of my near 60 recommendations, at the time of this review, Elber at Drain & Plumbing is easily in the Top 3 of my recommendations.

user_reviews.Name: risa anav
user_reviews.Description:
It never fails how your house decides for an emergency right at a big holiday.  Our 65 year old plumbing line from the water main to the house gave way and was leaking water from under our landscaping, down our driveway, and into the street Wednesday late afternoon before Thanksgiving.   I googled emergency plumbers in our area.  Luckily, Julio (Shark Plumbing) was nearby and was able to come by in 10 minutes.   It was a substantial project to replace the line with copper pipe and would entail digging a trench through our front landscaping. He was knowledgable and able to give us a detailed explanation of the job and relevant codes.  Julio gave us a fair quote for an emergency job and told us that it would look like he was never there. I was thinking, 'we shall see.'

He connected a bypass Wednesday evening to stop the leak and let us have water.  Then 8 am Thanksgiving morning he came out with his crew and started digging.  They were organized and moved the mulch and garden drips, dug the trench to have minimal impact to my plants. They got everything dug (heavy wet clay) and the pipe laid before only turning off the water for the final connections. We were only without water for about 2 hours.  He was great with communication and his crew were hardworking, clean, and worked with minimal disruption to us.  I was cooking a turkey inside.  When they were finished around 3 pm, I was amazed at how my front yard looked.  They did indeed put it back together as if they were never there.  They took all garbage away with them.  The copper front connections looked great.  They even repaired the small drywall that they had to cut open to run the connection into the garage.

My experience with Shark plumbing was extremely positive and I only have praise for their work and professionalism.  They saved our Thanksgiving.  I appreciated their work and hope they were able to spend the evening with their families.

user_reviews.Name: John Al-Samarrie
user_reviews.Description:
OK, this is overdue.  Last month I noticed water on the garage cement floor and thought it was just moisture.  After careful review I noticed that the water heater was leaking.  I called four different plumbers to get estimates with Drain Doctor being the first one I called.  A little history of my previous water heater is in order.  in 2019 I was overseas, and the heater broke and leaked all over the garage damaging some important personal items.  My girlfriend at the time called a plumber who installed a new heater and what a mess it was.  That plumber used galvanized steel for the inlet and outlet of the heater lines.  Routed the pressure relief pipe into the water heater pan rather than outside of the pan and installed my recirculating pump facing the side wall where I could not gain access.  Additionally, the gas line reservoir was installed by the water heater rather than near the gas line valve coming out of the wall.  There were no 2x4 boards in the back of the heater for earth quake bracing and the water lines were not earth grounded, all of which are city compliance requirement.  To say the least it was a cluster F.  When Bobby from Drain doctor showed up, he immediately pointed out the nonconformance of the water heater and gave me a bottom-line price from his standard pricing book which no other plumbers could beat.  Some quotes were almost double and after negotiating with those plumbers they got close to Bobby's price which didn't sit well with me.  So, I decided to go with Bobby and that proved to be fortuitist based on his efficient and compliant work.  Bobby is a plethora of plumbing information or more like a Wikipedia of plumbing.  He does have a laid back and straight forward attitude but don't let that fool you.  He's the top gun in his industry.  Anyway, I've read some of the negative reviews and in each case, there has been a unique set circumstance that all of us experienced in our daily life but over 99%+ of Drain Doctor reviews are very positive.  I can't tell you how happy we are with his work and in fact our outside main water line inlet valve was broken, unbeknown to us and we had him come back the next day to fix that as well.  I didn't bother getting other quotes because I knew Bobby would give us a competitive price but more importantly do the job right.
Anyway, you can't go wrong with Drain Doctor and ask for Bobby.  Bobby is your man.
Lastley, I don’t usually write reviews, but I was so impressed with the work I was compelled to write about our experience.
Thank you,
John A.

They responded quickly, arrived on time, and worked efficiently. The job was done cleanly and professionally, and everything was explained honestly without any unnecessary upselling.
They also cleaned up all materials and debris from the job and took everything with them, leaving the area spotless.
Fast, clean, and trustworthy — I highly recommend Shogun Plumbing.

user_reviews.Name: Megan D
user_reviews.Description: Don’t hesitate to call Danny. We’ve worked with a few plumbers and Danny was the best. Honest, timely, and very reasonable pricing. He came out to give us a second opinion and spent time to analyze the issue, attempt to fix it, and then provide the most reasonable quote when it turned out we needed a more advanced solution. He didn’t try to upsell, just gave us the best solution and explained every step. Additionally, he helped us after hours so he really went above and beyond!

We’re glad Danny could help, especially by going above and beyond after hours to make sure the issue was handled properly. If you ever need us again, we’re always here to help.

user_reviews.Name: Jonathan Chun
user_reviews.Description:
Hands down best contractor I have ever worked with from any trade. Professional, knowledgeable, fair, detail oriented, efficient, great value provided. I hired him to fix a leak under my toilet that another plumbing company had come to fix just under a year ago. Shogun plumbing was proactive about fixing problems they identify that will become future issues.
To give you a sense of just how detail oriented he made sure the toilet seat was recentered even though that wasn't part of fixing the leak. He just really cares and has great customer service.
